heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: 73 dead, 1,182+ injured, 40,000+ displaced after M7.7 quake struck 68km NNW of Ende at 10km depth on 15 August; BMKG has recorded 2,768+ aftershocks and predicts continued shaking for 21-30 more days.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
